locked_mechanism: Legal JSONC (comments or trailing commas) in the supported repository-root tsconfig.json is strict-parsed with json.loads inside a broad 'except Exception: pass', so both copies of _load_tsconfig_aliases return an empty alias table with no warning.

method.search_api: GitHub issue-search API, repo:FinanceFlash/unvibecode is:issue, open + closed
method.body_scan: GitHub REST issues endpoint; every issue created since the previous sweep was retrieved and its title and body scanned for the keywords below, then each keyword match was read in context

new_range_body_scan.note: 58 issues, not 59, because one number in the inclusive range is a pull request rather than an issue.

distinct.mechanism: strict-JSON config parses; ordinary imports are not resolved through baseUrl when no explicit paths table exists
strict-JSON configs parse; aliases inherited through extends or declared in non-root effective configs are not discovered
post-load target wildcard substitution loses the captured segment
unnormalized relative ../ specifiers never produce a candidate path in LanguageAwareImportResolver; parses no config, and its only tsconfig mention cross-references #455
conditional require/import calls lose alternative module paths during JS/TS import extraction; its json.loads occurrences are its own harness reading generated JSON
@/ imports recorded hard_path_skipped by the later linker, not an empty Stage-1 alias table
Connected Code Map skips valid TypeScript @/ path aliases at the linker stage
alias declared only in vite.config.ts / a non-root setup, not the supported root tsconfig.json

conclusion: #451 remains the single upstream report of the locked strict-JSON/JSONC empty-alias mechanism. The 2026-11-05 range adds no duplicate and no competing priority claim.

filing_position.requires: maintainer/organizer direction plus explicit repository-owner approval before any upstream action

chronology.interpretation: The personal evidence repository was public before #451 was filed, which supports independent derivation. It does not change the tracker fact that #451 is the first upstream report, and it is recorded neutrally without alleging copying by anyone.
